headline.583: The last exceptional triple is separated by packet covariants and closed by explicit degree-13 polynomial transpositions; all residual spectral collisions form a canonical finite equivalence groupoid.
headline.584: An explicit 12x12 F3 intertwiner identifies the colored 600-cell C3 module with the Hjelmslev packet module; exhaustive transport shows the full A4 is not spectral and only C3 survives.
headline.585: The 336 Singer objects are exactly pairs of a 3-subset and one of six Sylow-5 pentagons on its complement; the 56 Johnson quotient is the undecorated triple set and the fibre action is S5 with C3 kernel.
headline.586: The global cyclotomic order is correctly replaced by its localization at (lambda); the residue field is F5 and lambda^4=5u with u a local unit, yielding e=4 and f=1 arithmetically.
headline.587: Every infinite-horizon baseline policy has an explicit same-cost joint refinement, proving global continuous non-worsening and isolating strictness exactly to a decision-affinity condition; the aspirational uniform prior remains a candidate tie surface through M=24.
